# Agent Context

This directory contains repository context intended for coding agents and maintainers.
It is separate from the published documentation under `docs/`.

## Active context

- `instructions/master-coding-agent-instructions.md`: canonical repository engineering guidance.
- `feature-ledger.md`: dated record of implemented features and fixes.
- `notes/`: short operational and future-work notes.

## Archive

- `archive/changelogs/`: historical implementation and change records.
- `archive/dependency-preview/`: historical dependency-preview design and verification material.

Archive material is useful background, but it does not define current product behavior. Use
the public feature reference and current source code for that.
